newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends weaker, cocoa claws higher.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends weaker, cocoa claws higher.

text.p: COFFEE - Spurns NY and continues lower on origin sales, roaster buying seen at lows. May ends down $30 at $1,735.
COCOA - Claws back lost ground as May regains 1,000 stg level but ends touch weaker. May down four at 1,006 stg.
SUGAR - Heads lower with bearish raws, compounding earlier EU hedge sales. May down $1.10 at $305.70 at 1703 GMT.
